description: This file defines the class PearDatabase and related components for database interaction within the application, including connection management, query execution, caching, and utility functions. It incorporates licensing information and external dependencies like logging and ADODB libraries.

classes.name: PreparedQMark2SqlValue
classes.description: Utility class used internally to convert prepared statement placeholders '?' into actual SQL values based on provided parameters.

classes.name: PerformancePrefs
classes.description: Provides static methods to retrieve performance-related configuration settings, optionally from included config.performance.php.

classes.name: PearDatabaseCache
classes.description: Implements caching of query results to optimize repeated database access for SELECT queries.

classes.name: PearDatabase
classes.description: Main class for managing database connections, executing SQL queries with support for caching, transactions, and various database-specific operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database connection parameters and performance preferences.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection based on configuration and parameters.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query, leveraging cache if enabled, and handles logging and error checking.

methods.name: pquery
methods.description: Executes a prepared SQL statement with parameters, converting it if necessary, and utilizes query result caching.

methods.name: convert2Sql
methods.description: Converts a prepared statement with placeholders '?' into a full SQL statement by replacing placeholders with escaped values.

methods.name: flatten_array
methods.description: Recursively flattens multi-dimensional arrays into a single-dimensional array of values.

methods.name: updateBlob
methods.description: Updates a BLOB field in the database for a specific record.

methods.name: completeTransaction
methods.description: Commits or rolls back the current transaction based on success or failure.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Executes a SQL query expected to return a single value.

methods.name: getAffectedRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query executed.

methods.name: limitQuery
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with LIMIT and offset for pagination.

methods.name: requireSingleResult
methods.description: Executes a query and expects exactly one result row; returns the result or handles error.

methods.name: escapeDbName
methods.description: Escapes database name identifiers depending on the database type.
